newsitem.title: CHINA: Volkswagen Shanghai makes 20,251 Santanas in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen Shanghai makes 20,251 Santanas in Jan.

text.p: Shanghai Volkswagen Co produced 20,251 Santana cars in January, up 52.5 percent on the same month last year, the Business News said on Friday.

The newspaper said the joint venture between German automaker Volkswagen AG and the Shanghai Automobile Industrial Corp, established in 1985, had produced a cumulative 767,169 Santana sedans by the end of last month.
The company said earlier that it planned to produce 220,000 cars in 1997 against 200,000 last year.
Shanghai Volkswagen is the largest automaker in China with an annual output value of 20 billion yuan and its Santana cars have 54 percent of the nation's car market.
